desc.en: A huge Beastman, enshrined in the depths of ruins stretching far underground. It is braver and more intelligent than others of its kind. It seems to have reigned in the depths for countless years, but nobody knows any details about it.
desc.ja: 地底に広がる遺跡の奥深くに鎮座する巨大な獣人。その中でも特に勇猛で知性が高い。長い間、地底の主として君臨していたようだが詳細を知る者は誰もいない
